questions.instructions: `parameter` names a parameter under review and where it is declared. `hit` is one line a text search returned for that name, and `context` is the code around it. Does `hit` pass or read that same project parameter, rather than an argument of a builtin, standard library or framework call that merely shares its spelling, such as the key argument of a sort call?

criteria.true: the line passes or reads the parameter under review
criteria.false: the line belongs to a builtin, standard library or framework call that shares the name
